title: Vendor-risk outage on an otherwise trivial request

decision.recommendation: Escalate for review: Escalate for security review due to unavailable vendor risk assessment and overlapping existing tool; manager approval is also required before proceeding.

evidence.finding: Requester profile: Noah Williams, Finance, IC4, United Kingdom, manager Priya Shah.
Finance department software budget $90,000 annual, $61,000 already committed, $29,000 available; request $600 within budget.
Approved software catalog entry SW010: SignFlow, E-signature category, company‑wide approved, 45 seats, $16,000 annual cost, purchased by Finance on 2026‑07‑04.
Vendor registry record V010: SignFlow procurement, security, and legal status all Approved; last security review 2026‑06‑20 (102 days old, within policy review window).
External vendor risk assessment unavailable (HTTP 503 error).
Annual amount $600 falls in the tier requiring Manager.
Annual cost $600 is within Finance's available software budget of $29,000 ($28,400 left). This does not by itself mean the purchase should be approved.

Existing catalog software overlaps with this request: SignFlow (SW010, Approved, Company-wide, 45 seats; same vendor + same product + same category). Overlap is not a rejection - confirm the gap or use existing capacity first.
Vendor-risk service could not be reached for SignFlow (HTTP 503: Upstream vendor assessment provider is temporarily unavailable.). Risk status is unverified - not assuming a favourable result.

decision.next_step: Security team must perform a manual vendor risk assessment and determine whether the existing SignFlow license can satisfy the template use case before any purchase proceeds.
open_questions: Can the existing SignFlow license (SW010) provide the required reusable signing template functionality, or is an additional add‑on truly needed?
